newsitem.title: UK: BMW's Rover to unveil new Land Rover model.
newsitem.headline: BMW's Rover to unveil new Land Rover model.

text.p: The UK's Rover Group, a unit of Germany's BMW AG, said on Tuesday it would announce plans for a major investment in a new vehicle at its Land Rover plant in Solihull, central England.

Rover's chief executive Dr Walter Hasselkus would announce later in the day investment in a news sports utility vehicle which would be on sale in early 1998, Rover told Reuters at the British International Motor Show.
The new vehicle, part of an ongoing 3.5 billion pound investment programme at Rover, is expected to help support more than 10,000 jobs in the automotive supply sector.
It will also safeguard the 12,000 people working at Solihull as well as creating civil engineering jobs during the construction phase.

A new factory complex is being built at Solihull which will start production of new models towards the end of 1997. Rover said that by 2000 its Land Rover unit production would be three times higher than the 68,000 vehicles made in 1993.

World demand for Land Rover vehicles showed continued growth with sales rising more than 12 percent so far this year. Big increases have occurred in the U.S., Japan, Germany and South Africa, it said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
